title: Proteome-scale analysis of phase-separated proteins in immunofluorescence images.
authors: Yu, Chunyu; Shen, Boyan; You, Kaiqiang; Huang, Qi; Shi, Minglei; Wu, Congying; Chen, Yang; Zhang, Chaolin; Li, Tingting
one_liner_zh: 该文基于免疫荧光图像分析全蛋白质组相分离蛋白，虽涉及转录因子富集但与DNA互作无关，且方法为图像分析而非AI/物理模拟，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Phase separation is an important mechanism that mediates the spatial distribution of proteins in different cellular compartments. While phase-separated proteins share certain sequence characteristics, including intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) and prion-like domains, such characteristics are insufficient for making accurate predictions; thus, a proteome-wide understanding of phase separation is currently lacking. Here, we define phase-separated proteomes based on the systematic analysis of immunofluorescence images of 12 073 proteins in the Human Protein Atlas. The analysis of these proteins reveals that phase-separated candidate proteins exhibit higher IDR contents, higher mean net charge and lower hydropathy and prefer to bind to RNA. Kinases and transcription factors are also enriched among these candidate proteins. Strikingly, both phase-separated kinases and phase-separated transcription factors display significantly reduced substrate specificity. Our work provides the first global view of the phase-separated proteome and suggests that the spatial proximity resulting from phase separation reduces the requirement for motif specificity and expands the repertoire of substrates. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/cheneyyu/deepphase.
abstract_zh: 相分离 (phase separation) 是介导蛋白质在不同细胞区室中空间分布的重要机制。尽管相分离蛋白共享某些序列特征，包括 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 和 prion-like domains，但这些特征不足以进行准确预测；因此，目前缺乏对相分离的全蛋白质组层面的理解。在此，我们基于对 Human Protein Atlas 中 12 073 种蛋白质的免疫荧光图像的系统分析，定义了相分离蛋白质组。对这些蛋白质的分析揭示，相分离候选蛋白表现出更高的 IDR 含量、更高的平均净电荷和更低的疏水性，并倾向于结合 RNA。激酶和转录因子在这些候选蛋白中也富集。引人注目的是，相分离激酶和相分离转录因子均显示出显著降低的底物特异性。我们的工作提供了相分离蛋白质组的首个全局视图，并表明相分离产生的空间邻近性降低了对基序特异性的需求，并扩展了底物谱。源代码和数据可在 https://github.com/cheneyyu/deepphase 获取。
